title: Narrow-window steward runbook and staffing checkpad — 48hr miniwave
content:
Purpose and scope:
This is a compact steward runbook for a targeted 48-hour narrow-window miniwave. Use it for small, high-risk surface deploys (model variant swap, cache schema change, or routing policy tweak) where we need precise staffing and telemetry sampling rather than broad regional ramp-ups.

Objectives:
- Deploy change with minimal user-visible disruption.
- Validate latency and error-rate SLOs at 1%, 10%, 50% traffic increments.
- Collect focused quality and cost telemetry for 24h post-swap.
- Provide a clear rollback ladder with responsibilities.

High-level timeline (48h) — condensed: 
Day 0 — Preflight (T minus 12h to T minus 1h)
- T-12h: Final signoff from Product and SRE on release notes and customer-impact matrix (owner: Priya).
- T-8h: Merge gating PRs, run full smoke pipeline, and snapshot canary baseline metrics (owner: Liam).
- T-4h: Dry-run operator checklist in staging and replay a subset of traffic with traffic-sim harness (owner: Diego).
- T-1h: Quiet window begins: freeze non-critical deploys, notify all oncall channels, and confirm test users and synthetic probes (owner: Samira).

Day 1 — Cutover window (T0 to T+6h)
- T0: Swap routing policy to new variant for 1% traffic. Start high-fidelity sampling (100% of sampled requests go to both variants via shadowing where applicable).
- T+30m: Validate smoke tests, latency p95/p99, error budget burn. If stable, escalate to 10%. (owner: steward oncall).
- T+2h: Validate quality signals (eval shard from Optimize, human checks on a 20-sample set). If stable, escalate to 50% with throttled growth.
- T+6h: Hold and observe. If stable, open for limited ramp to full per product agreement.

Day 1+ onwards — Post-cutover (T+6h to T+48h)
- T+12h: Run secondary audit jobs: index KV cache health, disk/memory checks for dedicated nodes.
- T+24h: Convene 24h review: snapshot costs, token-per-second, and user-reported regressions.
- T+48h: Final stabilization retro and roll-forward notes.

Staffing and shifted owners:
- Steward lead: Samira Ortiz — overall coordination, comms, final rollback authority if SRE concurs.
- SRE primary: Liam Nguyen — telemetry, alarms, and rollback script execution.
- Serving runtime lead: Diego Morales — kernel toggles, batching parameters, trace hooks.
- Product quality: Priya Shah — signal acceptance, customer impact assessment.
- Backup steward: Ava Thompson — assumes tasks if primary is unavailable.
- Pager rotation: normal oncall cadence remains; this doc overlays a short steward roster for the 48h window.

Preflight checklist (quick):
- [ ] Jira ticket RE-2147 has acceptance criteria and rollback triggers defined.
- [ ] Release notes draft posted to /releases and notified to support via #support-release.
- [ ] Smoke pipeline green for three consecutive runs.
- [ ] Canary baseline snapshot collected (latency, error-rate, throughput, cost/tokens).
- [ ] Reserved quiet window on calendar and email/Slack pings sent to cross-functional watchers.
- [ ] Backup capacity validated (reserved Dedicated pool available at 2x normal).
- [ ] Rollback playbook staged and tested in staging (scripted).

Cutover steps (operator cheatpad):
1) Ensure remote terminal and jumpbox access for steward and SRE.
2) Run gating acceptance checklist on PR: migration, infra changes, service flags.
3) Deploy model/config to canaries (or update routing policy) for 1% traffic.
4) Enable high-frequency telemetry and shadowing.
5) Monitor health panel: p50/p95/p99, error-rate, tail-latency, steady KV hit-rate.
6) If any of the following triggers fire, immediately initiate rollback:
   - error-rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m at 1% traffic or >0.2% sustained for 10m at >=10% traffic
   - latency p99 regresses > 40% relative to baseline for 10m
   - user-facing regression triage reports >5 confirmed incidents in 1h
7) If thresholds hold, increment traffic per plan. Document each increment in the rollout log (see EVENTS table at end).

Smoke tests and synthetic probes (short list):
- Core generation smoke (5 short prompts, verify completions within latency SLO)
- Conversation continuity (KV cache warmup check)
- Edge-case prompt fuzzing (rate-limited batch)
- Embedding consistency check (sample 10 items vs previous model)
- Billing/cost sanity check (tokens per second and expected bill-rate baseline)

Telemetry sampling plan (focused):
- High-fidelity sampling: 100% shadow for sampled requests (first 5 minutes of each increment).
- Metric slices to prioritize: model_id, region, route, qos_tier, sequence_length_bucket.
- Logs: structured trace id included; request/response sample retention 72h for this wave.
- Eval hook: run Optimize evaluation job on a seeded prompt set (ID: RE-2147-EVAL) every hour for first 6h.

Rollback ladder (fastest path first):
- Quick undo: revert traffic routing policy to previous target (stepping down to 0% new variant). Estimated 90s to enact. (owner: steward + SRE).
- Full revert: redeploy previous model binary to canary and rollback any config changes. Estimated 6–12m including warming. (owner: serving runtime lead).
- Regional fallback: divert traffic to regional fallback pool (older variant) for affected regions only. (owner: SRE).

Post-release notes template (to fill during/after rollout):
- Summary: one-paragraph summary of change and motivation.
- Cutover time window and owner.
- Metrics snapshot: pre/post p95 latency, error-rate, tokens/sec, estimated cost delta.
- Observed regressions and mitigations.
- Customer-impact notes and support links.
- Follow-ups: list of follow-up tickets and owners.

EVENTS log (example entries to copy while running):
- 2029-03-04T09:00Z — T0: 1% traffic on new routing; stewards: Samira/Liam. Canary smoke green.
- 2029-03-04T09:30Z — escalated to 10% after 30m stable; note: small p99 bump in eu-west region, under threshold.
- 2029-03-04T11:50Z — 50% ramp starting; two minor anomalies in batch queue; mitigated with transient throttle.

Open questions / risks to resolve before go:
- Do we have a pre-authorized customer communication template if downstream customers see errors? (action: Priya)
- Confirm whether reserved Dedicated capacity is billable to feature budget or infra. (action: Finance liaison)
- Unknown: potential latency amplification on seq_lengths > 2048 under new kernel toggle — need synthetic stress. (action: Diego)

Quick comms checklist: 
- Post updates to #release-ops every traffic increment and on every fired trigger.
- Use Slack thread on RE-2147 for asynchronous notes and paste EVENTS entries into the ticket.
- If rolling back, escalate to exec-oncall only if customer-impacting and >30m unresolved.

After-action items (populate during 48h):
- Fill in evaluation job outputs and link to Optimize job run IDs.
- Add any unplanned follow-ups to RE-2147 backlog with owners and deadlines.
- Run short retro within 72h focusing on tooling gaps (telemetry gaps, rollback friction, staffing blind spots).

Notes to self: keep this doc compact and copyable into the deployment binder. Use the EVENTS log as the canonical short-form timeline for customer notes.

-- end of runbook --
